display: I have a plan at plan.md, with design context in design.md. Use the hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development skill to execute it. Two things about how I want it run: dispatch the task reviewers with run_in_background: true so they don't hold up the session, and when a reviewer finds problems, send the fix to the implementer that wrote the task with SendMessage instead of starting a new agent. Also, once Task 1 is approved, use SendMessage to ask Task 1's implementer to add a one-line module docstring to textstats/count.py before you start Task 2.
go ahead with what the plan says
